_meta: 헝가리어 회화 음성 — 목소리·감정·자리 채움(일본어앱 data/tts/voices.json 과 같은 짜임). 참고 음성은 영어(VoxCPM2 가 헝가리어 미지원), 문장은 MOSS-TTS 가 헝가리어로 읽는다.
base_text: I have a meeting this afternoon, so I am preparing everything now. Do you want to have dinner together afterwards?

am.desc: A young Hungarian man in his twenties, clear and gentle voice

af.desc: A young Hungarian woman in her twenties, clear and soft voice

anna.desc: A Hungarian woman in her early twenties, warm, sweet and curious voice

reka.desc: A Hungarian woman in her early twenties, direct, playful and quick voice

bence.desc: A Hungarian man in his mid twenties, relaxed, easygoing and slightly deep voice

david.desc: A Hungarian man in his mid twenties, energetic, frank and strong voice

man_y.desc: A Hungarian man around twenty, natural and clear voice

man_m.desc: A Hungarian man in his forties, steady and calm voice

man_o.desc: An elderly Hungarian man, low and slightly rough voice

woman_y.desc: A Hungarian woman around twenty, natural and clear voice

woman_m.desc: A Hungarian woman in her forties, steady and warm voice

woman_o.desc: An elderly Hungarian woman, soft and slightly shaky voice

neutral.instruct: calm and natural, everyday tone, natural conversational pace, subtle
neutral.ref: I have a meeting this afternoon, so I am preparing the documents now.

polite.instruct: polite and professional, like a clerk or station staff, natural conversational pace, subtle
polite.ref: Good afternoon. Your order is ready. Please enjoy your meal.

stiff.instruct: very nervous and stiff, formal and overly polite, natural conversational pace, subtle
stiff.ref: Thank you very much for your time today. I will do my very best.

cheerful.instruct: cheerful, bright and friendly, natural conversational pace, subtle
cheerful.ref: Oh, you made it! The weather is great and I feel wonderful today.

amused.instruct: amused, laughing warmly, relaxed, natural conversational pace, subtle
amused.ref: Ha ha, that is so funny. Yes, keep going just like that.

teasing.instruct: teasing, playful and mischievous, natural conversational pace, subtle
teasing.ref: Oh, what is that face? Come on, be honest. I will not tell anyone.

excited.instruct: excited, bursting with energy, bright and loud, natural conversational pace, subtle
excited.ref: No way, this is amazing! We really have to go there right now!

surprised.instruct: surprised, caught off guard, voice jumps, natural conversational pace, subtle
surprised.ref: Wait, what? Really? I had no idea at all!

shout.instruct: loud comic retort, not screaming, natural conversational pace, subtle
shout.ref: Hey! What are you doing? Come on!

tsukkomi.instruct: a quick sharp comic retort, exasperated but fond, natural conversational pace, subtle
tsukkomi.ref: Oh come on, that is not what I said at all!

annoyed.instruct: annoyed, irritated, sighing, natural conversational pace, subtle
annoyed.ref: Seriously, again? I told you this three times already.

sad.instruct: a little sad and quiet, natural conversational pace, subtle
sad.ref: I see. I thought it would be different this time.

worried.instruct: a little worried, hesitant, natural conversational pace, subtle
worried.ref: Are you sure it is okay? I really do not know about this.

flustered.instruct: a little embarrassed and unsure, natural conversational pace, subtle
flustered.ref: Oh, no, I did not mean that, I just, um, sorry.

shy.instruct: shy, soft, slightly trailing off, natural conversational pace, subtle
shy.ref: Well, if you are free, maybe we could go together.

gentle.instruct: gentle, warm and tender, quiet, natural conversational pace, subtle
gentle.ref: It is all right. I am here, so take your time.
